release_version: Pack release with definition revision/digest, mapping version and policy version separate.
same_meaning: Same stable ID for same operational meaning/scope; new immutable release/revision for editorial labels.
meaning_change: New semantic ID with explicit replacement relation; never redefine/reuse prior ID.
split_merge: Explicit replacement set + reviewed mappings/new artifacts; no automatic inheritance.
alias: Same-meaning approved synonyms scoped by language/context/release; broader/narrower/related meanings forbidden as aliases.
pins: role semantic policy version when applicable
v1_compatibility: Target and candidate use identical pinned definition/pack release per capability in one context. Different releases fail closed until explicit compatibility/adaptation approved.
historical: Exact immutable archived records resolve under explicit historical mode; historical eligibility is not current eligibility.
